name: clean-view
description: Restyles Claude's own to-do list in the transcript: a header with the count, a pixel progress bar, and a pixel bar for each item.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Task View off to get Claude Code's normal to-do rows back and stop the moving bars.

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: The accent colour of the bars. Same as Bottom Bar follows the Bottom Bar's Colour setting.

barSize.title: Bar size
barSize.description: How long the pixel bars are: Small, Medium or Large. Default: Medium.

showMainBar.title: Show the list bar
showMainBar.description: Show the one pixel bar for the whole list under the header.

showItemBars.title: Show a bar on each item
showItemBars.description: Show a small pixel bar at the end of each to-do line.

maxItems.title: Most items shown
maxItems.description: How many to-dos are drawn from one list, from 1 to 100. Default: 24.

maxNameLength.title: Longest item name
maxNameLength.description: Item names longer than this many characters are cut with an ellipsis, from 10 to 300. Default: 120.
